title: Here's What's Preventing You From Finishing Projects
summary: Zack Freedman gives advice on why makers fail to finish projects, including scrapping bad ideas, showing work publicly and writing a plan that keeps projects fun. It is aimed at hardware DIY but generalizes.
why: HN finds the project-scoping rubric useful for programmers too and recommends it on finishing side projects.

quote.text: the rubric he uses is sound for programmer-y stuff too
